Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro to Economic Buyer & Budget Confirmation - ACME Corp

Hi Alicia / John —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery:

- Primary use case: customer support summarization + internal KB search for faster TTR.
- Success criteria discussed: sub-200ms p95 for short responses, 30-40% reduction in average handle time, and predictable token costs under $X/month.
- Security requirements: SOC 2 compliant hosting, VPC option for data isolation, and audit log access for model inferences.

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) Confirm the economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on procurement timelines and put together a PO-friendly proposal.
2) Share our MAF worksheet (attached) to map technical and procurement asks.
3) Schedule a short (30 min) procurement/finance intro with your budget owner this week if possible.

Alicia — could you introduce me to the person who owns the budget? If John is the right contact I’ve looped him here; otherwise happy to be connected to the SVP of Finance or Procurement lead.

I’ve attached a filled MAF worksheet and a pricing summary for reference.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — great summary.

John is our SVP Finance and the right economic buyer for platform spends like this. I’ve copied him. Procurement (procurement@acme-corp.com) typically handles the contract and PO once John signs off.

John — Marissa is our point of contact at Redwood; they shared a short MAF + pricing. Can you confirm whether this scope aligns with the FY27 procurement plan? If helpful, we can do a 20-30 minute sync to go over budget and approval timing.


Alicia
Alicia Barnes

Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro to Economic Buyer & Budget Confirmation - ACME Corp

John — thanks for being looped in. A couple quick asks so we can move to a procurement-ready proposal: 

1) Can you confirm the approximate budget band you’re targeting for this initiative this fiscal year (ranges are fine — e.g., <$50k, $50-200k, >$200k)?
2) Who on your side should we engage for contract redlines and technical security questionnaires (procurement@acme-corp.com is fine; if you prefer a named person that helps us track).
3) If you’re open, we can schedule a 20-minute call next week to walk through the value metrics and a PO-friendly commercial outline.

For context: we attached a two-page pricing summary and a MAF worksheet that maps features to compliance and deployment options. If you’d like, Ben (cc’d; our solutions lead) can join the budget call to answer any technical or deployment questions.

Proposed slots: Tue 11/10 10:00-10:30 PT, Tue 11/10 15:00-15:30 PT. What works for you?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Marissa / Alicia — thanks for the background and the materials.

Budget: for FY27 we have a mid-market innovation bucket in the $50-200k range that this would likely draw from - that should be sufficient for a pilot + initial production rollout if we keep expected token usage in the ranges discussed.

Procurement: I’ve cc’d procurement@acme-corp.com (Sally is the lead). Sally — please advise on ACME’s standard security questionnaire and whether you need an executed NDA before we share any more detailed logs or PII-handling docs.

I can do Tue 11/10 at 10:00 PT for a quick sync with Marissa and Ben to align on commercial terms. If you could send a short, PO-friendly quote and the procurement questionnaire link before the call, that will help speed approvals.

Thanks,
